extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of roughly 70 million Creative-Commons-licensed images paired with high-quality synthetic captions generated using BLIP-2, curated for training text-to-image generative models.
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan (Comell Tech); A. Feder Cooper (Comell Tech); Jasmine Collins (Databricks Mosaic); Landan Seguin (Databricks Mosaic); Austin Jacobson (Databricks Mosaic); Mihir Patel (Databricks Mosaic); Jonathan Frankle (Databricks Mosaic); Cory Stephenson (Databricks Mosaic); Volodymyr Kuleshov (Comell Tech)
extraction.citeAs: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov. CommonCanvas: An Open Diffusion Model Trained with Creative-Commons Images. arXiv:2310.16825v1, 2023.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were collected by re-scraping high-resolution Creative-Commons images from Flickr using the Flickr IDs provided in the YFCC100M dataset metadata.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The collected Creative-Commons images suffered from data incompleteness, as almost all of them lacked the text captions necessary to train text-to-image generative models.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of the YFCC100M dataset, which contains metadata and Flickr IDs, and the corresponding source images hosted on Flickr.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Producing synthetic captions for curated, open licensed Creative-Commons images using a pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Underperformed in several categories, including faces, general photography, and paintings; reduced diversity of n-grams in synthetic captions; it is still possible for an adversarial prompt to produce content that includes iconic characters.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset addresses copyright concerns and unclear provenance associated with web-scraped data by using only open-licensed Creative-Commons images, and the resulting models are better at avoiding generating potentially problematic data such as copyrighted iconic characters.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training text-to-image (T2I) generative models; fine-tuning models for specific categories by supplementing with user datasets.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: We address the data incompleteness problem by using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model, which we use to produce high-quality, synthetic captions for a set of curated, open licensed CC images that lack captions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We exclude images with non-derivative (ND) licenses. We center-cropped and resized all of the images to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels.
